meta.title: Local HTML Tools
meta.description: A curated directory of browser-first tools where the browser does the work, especially single-file and offline-friendly HTML utilities with limited network or API dependence.

tools.name: Chrome Session Viewer
tools.summary: Parse Chrome session files in the browser-tabs, groups, history-with export. No data leaves your device.

tools.name: Browser Extensions Icons
tools.summary: Convert SVG to standard extension icon PNGs (16-128px) and zip them with sample manifest snippets-all client-side.

tools.name: Make Colors Transparent in PNG
tools.summary: Open an image, click colors to chroma-key them transparent, preview on checkerboard, download PNG.

tools.name: PyPI changelog diff
tools.summary: Paste a package name and compare two PyPI releases; copy a unified diff of changes.

tools.name: svg-render
tools.summary: Render SVG to downloadable JPEG or PNG (optional remote SVG via URL parameter).

tools.name: JustHTML playground
tools.summary: Try the JustHTML Python parser in the browser via Pyodide with a small HTML UI.

tools.name: Image resize and quality comparison
tools.summary: Compare JPEG quality settings side by side when resizing images. Visually find the optimal balance between file size and quality.

tools.name: Image to JPEG
tools.summary: Convert PNG or WebP images to JPEG format entirely in the browser. Useful for compressing screenshots or photos before sharing.

tools.name: Image to SVG
tools.summary: Trace bitmap images and convert them to SVG vector paths in your browser. Handy for turning logos or sketches into scalable vectors.

tools.name: EXIF Viewer
tools.summary: Extract EXIF and GPS metadata from uploaded images. Inspect camera settings, dates, and location data embedded in photos.

tools.name: Compare PDFs
tools.summary: Visualize differences between two uploaded PDF documents. See exactly what changed between versions without any data leaving your machine.

tools.name: JSON to YAML
tools.summary: Convert between JSON and YAML formats bidirectionally. Essential config wrangling tool with live preview of the conversion.

tools.name: YAML Explorer
tools.summary: Browse YAML documents in a collapsible tree view. Navigate complex nested YAML structures much more easily than reading raw text.

tools.name: Text Diff
tools.summary: Character-level diff between two texts with side-by-side highlighting. Fast, local, and private - no data sent to any server.

tools.name: Writing Style Analyzer
tools.summary: Find weasel words, passive voice, cliches, and duplicate phrases in your writing. A plain-text editing companion for clearer prose.

tools.name: Emoji Identifier
tools.summary: Paste any emoji and get its official name, Unicode codepoint, and category. Perfect for when you need the exact name of that emoji.

tools.name: Alt Text Extractor
tools.summary: Extract images and their alt text from pasted rich content into clean Markdown or HTML. Essential for auditing accessibility of copied content.

tools.name: HTML preview
tools.summary: Type HTML on the left and see it rendered live on the right. A fast scratchpad for prototyping markup without any server round-trips.

tools.name: Clipboard viewer
tools.summary: Debug everything stored in your clipboard across all formats - HTML, plain text, RTF, images. Invaluable for understanding paste behavior.

tools.name: JSON Diff
tools.summary: Side-by-side JSON comparison with syntax highlighting of additions, removals, and changes. Much clearer than raw textual diffs for structured data.

tools.name: SQL Pretty Printer
tools.summary: Reformat SQL queries for readability with configurable indentation and line breaks. Turns monstrous one-liners into readable statements.

tools.name: DOT Graph Renderer
tools.summary: Render Graphviz DOT files to SVG in real-time as you type. Perfect for quickly visualizing dependency graphs, flowcharts, and state machines.

tools.name: Terminal to HTML
tools.summary: Convert ANSI terminal output with colors and styling to clean HTML. Share command output, error logs, or terminal recordings on the web.

tools.name: JSON schema builder
tools.summary: Visually design and build JSON schemas with a structured form interface. Generates the schema as you add properties, types, and constraints.

tools.name: Escape Entities
tools.summary: HTML entity encoder and decoder. Quickly escape or unescape special HTML characters for safe embedding in web pages.

tools.name: Zip/Wheel explorer
tools.summary: View the contents of Python wheel and ZIP archive files in a browsable interface. Inspect package structure without extracting locally.

tools.name: XML Validator
tools.summary: Validate XML documents for well-formedness and report parse errors with line numbers. A quick sanity check for any XML file.

tools.name: Incomplete JSON printer
tools.summary: Pretty-print partial or incomplete JSON documents. Perfect for viewing streaming JSON responses from LLMs and APIs that arrive in chunks.

tools.name: Pomodoro Timer
tools.summary: Full-featured productivity timer with configurable intervals, session goals, history tracking, and JSON export. Works entirely offline.

tools.name: Annotated Presentations
tools.summary: Create accessible slide presentations with alt text on images, Markdown speaker notes, and built-in OCR for scanned slide decks.

tools.name: FFmpeg crop helper
tools.summary: Load a video frame and draw a crop region interactively. Instantly generates the exact FFmpeg command for that crop - no more trial and error.

tools.name: MP3 Inspector
tools.summary: Extract ID3 metadata from MP3 files - title, artist, album, genre, cover art, and more. Useful for auditing or cleaning up music collections.

tools.name: Speech Synthesis Tester
tools.summary: Test the Web Speech API text-to-speech engine with different voices, rates, and pitches. See what voices your browser supports natively.

tools.name: Timestamp Converter
tools.summary: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa. Supports millisecond timestamps and multiple timezone displays.

tools.name: Timezones
tools.summary: Compare times across multiple timezones simultaneously on an interactive world clock. Indispensable for scheduling across timezones.

tools.name: Encrypt / decrypt message
tools.summary: Securely encrypt messages with a passphrase for sharing. Everything happens client-side - no server ever sees your plaintext or key.

tools.name: QR Code Decoder
tools.summary: Decode QR codes from an uploaded image or directly from your camera. Useful for scanning codes without a phone or proprietary app.

tools.name: Squoosh
tools.summary: Image compression tool from GoogleChromeLabs. Compare before/after, adjust quality, and convert formats locally in the browser.

tools.name: SVGOMG
tools.summary: Powered by SVGO, this client-side SVG optimizer lets you visually inspect and minify SVG markup with a rich settings panel.

tools.name: JS Paint
tools.summary: A pixel-perfect web remake of classic MS Paint with extras: themes, unlimited undo, transparent images, and animated GIF export.

tools.name: JS IMAGE CARVER
tools.summary: Content-aware image resizer and object remover based on the Seam Carving algorithm. Runs entirely in the browser.

tools.name: Cropper.js
tools.summary: A JavaScript image cropper demo that lets you crop, rotate, zoom, and export images locally in the browser.

tools.name: imgToAscii
tools.summary: Convert images to ASCII art in the browser. Supports color output and resizing with a simple JavaScript API.

tools.name: JSON Crack
tools.summary: Visualize JSON, YAML, CSV, and XML into interactive graphs and trees. Data is processed only on your device.

tools.name: Flexbox Froggy
tools.summary: A game for learning CSS flexbox. Write CSS to guide a frog to its lilypad through 24 interactive levels.

tools.name: Excalidraw
tools.summary: A virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams. End-to-end encrypted, works offline, and supports collaboration.

tools.name: Signature Pad
tools.summary: A smooth signature drawing demo using HTML5 canvas with variable width Bezier curves. Export to PNG, JPEG, or SVG.

tools.name: WebUtils
tools.summary: 999+ single-file, offline-first web tools covering JSON formatting, regex testing, image compression, QR codes, base64, color pickers, and more. Zero build, privacy-first, MIT licensed.

tools.name: Awfice
tools.summary: The world's smallest office suite - a word processor, spreadsheet, drawing app, presentation maker, and code editor, each under 1KB of JavaScript. Single-file HTML that runs as data: URLs.

tools.name: Markdeep
tools.summary: Turn any markdown file into a self-contained HTML document by adding one line at the bottom. Supports diagrams, LaTeX equations, calendars, citations, and works offline with no server needed.

tools.name: Networking Toolbox
tools.summary: 100+ offline-first networking tools for sysadmins: subnet calculator, MAC lookup, port scanner, DNS tools, IP tools, and more. Mobile optimized with dark/light themes.

tools.name: Dev Toolkit
tools.summary: 9-in-1 browser developer toolkit in a single HTML file: JSON formatter, Base64/URL/HTML encoder, JWT decoder, regex tester, markdown preview, diff checker, and more. Zero dependencies.

tools.name: Textarea.my
tools.summary: Minimalist text editor that lives entirely in the URL hash with deflate compression. Share notes by URL, supports markdown, custom CSS, dark mode, and QR code export. PWA offline.

tools.name: Conway's Game of Life
tools.summary: Interactive single-file HTML implementation of Conway's Game of Life with draw/erase, shape library (Glider, Gosper Gun, etc.), speed control, zoom, and generation counters.

tools.name: SingleFile
tools.summary: Browser extension and CLI tool to save a complete web page (CSS, images, fonts, frames) as a single HTML file. Supports auto-save, annotations, and cloud uploads.

tools.name: Kapur
tools.summary: Lightweight Markdown editor with syntax highlighting and instant preview. Single HTML file, zero dependencies, works offline. Supports GFM, file open/save, and HTML export.

tools.name: Hex Viewer
tools.summary: Browser-based hex viewer from the WebUtils collection. View file contents as hexadecimal with ASCII side panel. Works fully offline, drag-and-drop support.

tools.name: Retro Ball
tools.summary: Minimal Breakout-style arcade game in a single HTML file. Pure HTML, CSS, JS, runs completely offline. Responsive desktop and mobile, ball physics with paddle control.

tools.name: Acme Markdown Previewer
tools.summary: RTL-friendly single-file Markdown previewer with syntax highlighting, autosave, multiple documents, share by link, PDF download, dark theme, and PWA offline support.

tools.name: EdgeMD Viewer
tools.summary: Distraction-free Markdown viewer and editor. Single HTML file, zero dependencies, works offline. Drag-and-drop files, edit and save back, export as standalone HTML.

tools.name: UltraFormat
tools.summary: Privacy-first developer toolkit: JSON formatter, diff checker, Base64 codec, code beautifier, regex tester, JWT decoder, color converter, hash generator, UUID generator, and more. 100% client-side.

tools.name: HTML Snake Game
tools.summary: Single-file HTML snake game with keyboard and touchscreen support. Pure vanilla JavaScript, no dependencies, works completely offline. Editable variables for customization.

tools.name: Phrame
tools.summary: Simple PWA photo frame tool. Open a photo file in the browser, displayed without distraction. Single HTML file, works offline, installable as PWA.

tools.name: Video Toolkit
tools.summary: Fast browser-based video tools via ffmpeg.wasm. Shrink to target size, convert codecs, remux, extract audio, trim, thumbnails, GIFs. Files stay on your machine.

tools.name: Map a Route
tools.summary: Route planner for runners and cyclists. Click to drop points, snap to real paths, see elevation, export GPX. No account, no server.

tools.name: Cron Builder
tools.summary: Visual cron expression builder with 6 export formats: crontab, launchd, systemd, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes CronJob, node-cron. Single HTML file, no backend.

tools.name: JWT Debugger
tools.summary: Decode JWT tokens entirely in the browser. Inspect header, payload, and signature claims. Never sends your token anywhere - 100% client-side.

tools.name: Pattern Monster
tools.summary: Create seamless SVG patterns for website backgrounds, headers, and design. 320+ patterns with customizable colors, stroke width, and angle.

tools.name: HTML5 Webcam Tester
tools.summary: Test your webcam in the browser. View live feed, capture photos, decode QR codes, and switch cameras. All processing is local.

tools.name: UUID Tools
tools.summary: Online UUID/GUID generator supporting v1 and v4. Bulk generation, UUID decoder, API, and open source. Runs client-side.
